title: Unique Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct value in an array has a unique occurrence count.
explanation: Count each value and verify that the frequency values themselves are all distinct.

title: Minimum Cost to Move Chips to The Same Position
statement: Return the minimum cost to move all chips to one position when moving by two costs zero and moving by one costs one.
explanation: Only parity matters; move all chips to whichever parity group is larger.

title: Split a String in Balanced Strings
statement: Split a balanced string into the maximum number of balanced substrings, each containing equal L and R characters.
explanation: Increment for L and decrement for R; each time the balance returns to zero, one balanced piece is complete.

title: Check If It Is a Straight Line
statement: Return true if all coordinate points lie on one straight line.
explanation: Compare each point’s cross product with the vector from the first two points, avoiding slope division.

title: Cells with Odd Values in a Matrix
statement: Starting with a zero matrix, increment every cell in each selected row and column and count cells with odd values.
explanation: Track the number of increments per row and column; a cell is odd when the two counts sum to an odd number.

title: Shift 2D Grid
statement: Shift every grid cell k positions right in row-major order, wrapping around at the end.
explanation: Flatten the grid, rotate by k modulo the number of cells, and reshape it to the original dimensions.

title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
statement: Return the minimum time to visit points in order when diagonal, horizontal, and vertical moves each take one second.
explanation: Between consecutive points, the minimum time is max(abs(dx), abs(dy)).

title: Find Winner on a Tic Tac Toe Game
statement: Return A, B, Draw, or Pending for a valid sequence of tic-tac-toe moves.
explanation: Apply moves alternately and check the moved player’s row, column, and applicable diagonals after each move.

title: Subtract the Product and Sum of Digits of an Integer
statement: Return the product of the digits minus their sum.
explanation: Extract digits with division and remainder while maintaining their product and sum.

title: Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits
statement: Return how many integers in the array have an even number of decimal digits.
explanation: Count digits by repeatedly dividing by ten, then check whether the count is even.
